hits.snippet: Nova Intelligence raises $40M to ... What's the deal? Nova Intelligence has raised $40M across seed and Series A rounds to build an AI platform purpose-built for SAP teams. The Series A was led by Chemistry, with participation from Accel, Conviction, and SAP.iO. The seed round was led by Accel, with participation from Conviction and SAP.iO. ... The signal: Nova's $40M raise underscores a growing investor conviction that the biggest AI opportunities in enterprise software lie not in horizontal copilots but in vertical platforms purpose-built for specific ecosystems. With SAP's mandatory 2030 migration deadline creating a time-bound, trillion-dollar modernisation wave, the early-growth company is positioning itself at the intersection of urgency and complexity — exactly where AI agents can compress the seven-to-one services-to-software spending ratio that has long defined the SAP world.
